text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's too bad. And you were so close.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I told you at the start—I didn't really
want one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
We don't have time to waste. Let's just
head
back.
